meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline_en: Compute astronomical data with units, coordinates, and FITS in Python

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Astropy 的 API 编写和调试天文 Python 代码,处理单位换算、坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、表格、时间与宇宙学计算,并产出可运行的代码片段。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或调试使用 Astropy 的天文数据分析代码时触发,例如涉及坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、单位换算等。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes and debugs astronomy Python code with Astropy APIs: unit and quantity conversion, coordinate transforms, FITS read/write, tables, time handling, and cosmology calculations, producing runnable code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to implement or debug astronomical data analysis code with Astropy, e.g. work involving coordinates, FITS files, or units.
